11
Substance X is electrolysed.
A different gas is produced at each electrode. The gases are collected and tested at
room temperature.
One of the gases produces a squeaky pop when tested with a lighted splint. The other gas bleaches
damp litmus paper.
What is substance X?
A
concentrated aqueous sodium chloride
B
dilute sulfuric acid
C
molten lead(II) bromide
D
molten potassium chloride
subject: Chemistry
